$comment: The Blicks style engine, declared once. scripts/gen-engine.mjs generates the TS, PHP and SCSS tables from this file; never edit those by hand. Run `pnpm gen:engine` after changing it.

stateControls.$comment: States limited to the controls they are for. Every other state styles every control, which repeats each control's rules once per state and breakpoint; a press or a reduced-motion look never needs a grid placement, so these two carry only what they change.

controls.note: Several animations on one block: a comma-separated list of names, with matching comma-separated lists in animation.duration, animation.easing and the rest (e.g. "bl-anim-txt-type, bl-anim-txt-caret").

relations.note: Flex fields apply when display is flex.
Grid fields apply when display is grid.
Gap applies under flex or grid only.
A grid parent gives each child the Grid child controls.
A flex parent gives each child the Flex child controls.
Multi-column is inert on a flex or grid container.
Line clamp forces display:-webkit-box and hidden overflow.
Min and max refine width.
Min and max refine height.
Overflow is the shorthand for the per-axis values.
Scroll settings only matter once the box scrolls.
Snap stop only acts once a snap type is set.
Children only snap when the parent has a snap type.
A container name needs a container type.
Intrinsic size only matters with content-visibility: auto.
A fixed height beats the aspect ratio.
Inset and z-index need a positioned box.
Orientation applies to vertical writing only.
A type role sets these through a class; a field value overrides it.
A gradient or image text colour writes the background and clips it to the text.
One fill source at a time.
Both are background-image; only one survives.
Placement only applies to an image.
Same name, different property: fill layers vs the block against its backdrop.
Origin and 3D only matter with a transform.
Most presets animate transform and opacity while they run.
A preset fills in its default timing.
Fill target applies only to the bl-fill preset.
Range needs a scroll or view timeline.
Both write column-gap; the later rule wins.
Same CSS order, and both break reading order.
Isolation contains a child blend mode.
Layers write the background shorthand, which replaces the single-image controls.

css.description: One CSS value for the property named in `x-property`, validated whole: no `;`, `{`, `}`, `<` or `url(`. A value that fails is dropped.

tokenOrCss.description: A token slug from the scale named in `x-tokens`, or one CSS value for the property, validated whole. A value that fails is dropped.

sides.description: Per side. A length (`16px`, `1.5rem`, `50%`), a bare number (px), or a token slug from the scale named in `x-tokens`. An unset side is `0`; a plain string or number means the same on every side.

sidesKeyword.description: Per side: a keyword or colour (or a token slug from the scale named in `x-tokens`). An unset side gets the property's initial value; a plain string means the same on every side.

corners.description: Per corner. A length (`16px`, `1.5rem`, `50%`), a bare number (px), or a token slug from the scale named in `x-tokens`. An unset corner is `0`; a plain string or number means the same on every corner.

inset.description: `top`/`right`/`bottom`/`left` of a positioned box. A length (`16px`, `1.5rem`, `50%`), a bare number (px), or a token slug from the scale named in `x-tokens`. On the block an unset side is `0`, so set every side you mean and `auto` for the rest; on a pseudo-element an unset side stays `auto`.

color.description: A colour token slug or any CSS colour.

token.description: A shadow token slug; the layer is the theme's shadow.

color.description: A colour token slug or any CSS colour.

token.description: A shadow token slug; the layer is the theme's shadow.

boxShadow.description: A shadow token slug, one layer, or a list of layers stacked first-on-top. Lengths default to `0px`, colour to a faint black. If any layer fails validation the whole shadow is dropped.

oneOf.description: A raw outline, e.g. `2px dashed currentColor`, or `none`.

color.description: A colour token slug or any CSS colour. Default `currentColor`.

outline.description: An outline drawn outside the border; it takes no space. Set `effects.outlineOffset` for the gap. Usually written in the `focus` state for a keyboard focus ring.

textShadow.description: One text shadow `{ x, y, blur, color }` (needs `x` or `y`; the rest default to `0px` and a faint black), or a list of them, first on top. CSS text such as `0 1px 2px #000, 0 0 8px red` is read into this shape too.

oneOf.description: A gradient token slug, or a raw CSS gradient.
Stops (two or more), or `from`/`to` for two colours.

gradient.description: A gradient token slug, a raw CSS gradient, or a stops object.

backgroundLayers.description: Background layers, top first. Each keeps its own placement; the flat colour stays with `colors.background`. An unusable layer is left out.

image.description: A picture URL: http(s) or site-relative. Anything else is dropped.

clipPath.description: A preset shape with an amount, or a raw clip-path.

backdropFilter.description: A raw backdrop-filter, or any of `blur`, `brightness`, `saturate`, `contrast`.

oneOf.description: A raw mask image, e.g. a gradient.

mask.description: A preset fade, or a raw mask image.

oneOf.description: A transform token slug or a raw transform.

transform.description: A token slug, a raw transform, or named parts composed in a fixed order: translate, rotate, scale, skew.

content.description: Plain text (quoted for you), a CSS keyword, `attr(name)`, or `counter()`/`var()`. Pseudo-elements only.

valueTree.description: Every control's value is stored per state and breakpoint: `{ <state>: { <breakpoint>: value } }`. States: `default`, `hover`, `focus`, `active`; `group` / `groupActive` (its card hovered / pressed); `play`, `on`, `groupOn` (set by interactions); `reduced` (visitor reduces motion). A part (`before`, `after`) may lead, alone or with a state: `after:play`, `before:hover`. Breakpoints: `base`, `tablet`, `mobile`. Most writes are `{ "default": { "base": value } }`.
